How to set the proxy (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac)

ANDROID: Settings › Wi-Fi › long-press (or ⚙) the network › Modify / Advanced › Proxy: Manual › Host %1$s, Port %2$s › Save.

iPHONE / iPAD: Settings › Wi-Fi › (i) next to the network › Configure Proxy › Manual › Server %1$s, Port %2$s › Save. (Or Automatic with URL %3$s)

WINDOWS: Settings › Network & internet › Proxy › Manual proxy setup › Set up › On › Address %1$s, Port %2$s › Save.

MAC: System Settings › Wi-Fi › Details › Proxies › Web proxy (HTTP) and Secure web proxy (HTTPS) › %1$s : %2$s.

To test, open any website. Open http://%1$s:%2$s on the other device to see these details again.
